preconditions.description: The land plot dimensions n and m are between 3 and 300, and the target time t is between 1 and 10^9.
The time values for flat (tp), ascent (tu), and descent (td) are between 1 and 100.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= row <= n and all(1 <= height <= 10**6 for height in row) for row in grid)
preconditions.description: The grid is an n x m matrix where each height is a positive integer not exceeding 10^6.

postconditions.description: The output rectangle is defined by upper-left corner (r1, c1) and lower-right corner (r2, c2), with each side having at least 3 squares.

postconditions.expression: abs(calculate_track_time(r1, c1, r2, c2, grid, tp, tu, td) - t) <= abs(calculate_track_time(r1_, c1_, r2_, c2_, grid, tp, tu, td) - t) for all (r1_, c1_, r2_, c2_) in valid_rectangles
postconditions.description: The chosen rectangle minimizes the absolute difference between the track time and the target time t, compared to all other valid rectangles.
